_meta.about: Every threshold and starting value of docs/ARCHITECTURE.md sections 5 and 6. Each leaf is {value, source}; source is the section number, 'estimate', or the API notes. D1 (Tue 10/27) and D6 (Sun 11/1) replace starting values; the plain values freeze into run.json and their sha256 is the config_hash on every sheet. Read with walkaround.contracts.load_thresholds().

proxy_fps.source: 16.2 (tracker confirms after 15 frames; E2 runs 15 then 10, 30 only if 15 fails)

image_only.source: 16.3 (image requests on door keyframes; one D1 video request for sigma_frame)

never_prompt.source: 2 Dropped; 5 step 5 (spatial phrasing is not honored)

voice_keywords.source: 5 step 11 (14 panel nouns plus 7 words, 21 under the cookbook's 50 cap)

topup_always.source: 5.4 (the car filter and the blur need them on the new clip)

car_box_containment_min.source: 5.1 item 1 (box area inside the largest car box)

area_floor_small.source: 5.1 item 1 (side mirror, headlight, tail light, license plate, face)

border_frac_keyframe_max.source: 5.1 item 2 (over it counts for coverage, never a keyframe)

c_floor.source: 5.1 item 1 (no hard c floor anywhere before the merge)

anchor_pass_coverage_below.source: 5.1 item 6 (longest track under 70% of visible frames)

prompt_box_pad_px.source: 5 step 6 (padded to at least 2 px per side, clamped half-open)

direction_min_px_per_frame.source: 5.2 item 1 (|median| under 2 px per frame gives unknown)

keyframe_score_exponents.source: 5.3 (a plain product; exponents 1.0 are the weights)

fast_mask_decode.source: panels lane 11/1: walkaround/fastmask.py, the same rasters as meta_sam_parser bit for bit on every mask of pairC_core1's walk lanes, about 7x faster; false sends every keyframe mask to the DecodePool

keyframe_panels_in_flight.source: panels lane 11/1, estimate: panels scored, tested and blurred at once; each blur is 2 image requests, under orchestrator.sam_image_semaphore 16

door_glass_edge.source: lead 11/1, 2 m laps: a door box reaching the top of the frame is cut there by its glass, so the box pass leaves the top edge out of a door's border share; the mask pass measures completeness after the car windows are cut out (synth_pair2 offline: front doors G4 0.63 to 0.96 and 0.99)

fender_from_wheels.source: lead 11/1: SAM 3.1 has no noun for the panel over a wheel, so each wheel track gives a fender track (side from the wheel or the decided doors beside it) whose keyframe mask is the car mask near the wheel less every named part; sizes in wheel diameters d, estimates

view_match_return.source: lead 11/1: the return walk puts first the candidate whose whitened mask IoU with a pickup keyframe (same window cut, sharp enough for G3) beats the score order's best

twin_check.source: panels lane 11/1, measured offline on pairC_core1's stored lanes: plate on the lid in 84 to 96 of 92 to 96 plate frames on trunk lids and 0 of 65 to 71 on hoods; mirror 0.21 to 0.47 lid sizes from hoods and 2.6 from trunk lids; lights and glass placed by a lid were beside it on 97 to 100 percent of their frames, a mud flap the tail light lane tracked on 37 percent; margins and min_frames are estimates; absent (a run frozen before 11/1) means no check. margin_min 3 (review fix 11/1): one strong cue alone (plate or mirror) or the light and glass lanes alone, which swap themselves, no longer turn a walk's lid against its lane noun; that splits it instead (side uncertain, not compared). Every pair C lid decision scores 3 or 4 either way and is unchanged (pairC_core1's lanes, pairC_core2's tracks). photo_margin_min 2 keeps the claim photo's old rule, where Spark's own panel name must still agree

c_present_floor.source: 5.4 (C_PRESENT_FLOOR; below it the basis is area_only)

road_spray_min_marks.source: 5.6 (same type, horizontal band, bottom quarter of a door or bumper)

count_mode_new_point_min_units.source: 5.7 (farther than 0.1 units from every box-mode mark)

tau_pre_cap.source: 5.10 (above it the matcher is not calibrated)

sigma_spark.source: D1 E6 re-run on real marks at effort low, 5 calls per crop (runs/d1/uco3d_pairC/spark_redo/gate_spark.json): uCO3D pair C trunk chips 0.073 and 0.090 units, uCO3D Alto hood dent 0.117; the largest is kept. With it match.calibrate gives tau_pre0 0.4 (the cap) and tau_eye 0.8, the band lead note 3 on docs/D1_MEMO.md keeps. sigma_frame stays absent: E8's door-handle 0.11 to 0.17 would print a Stays Put tau_fix of 0.507, which note 2 refuses

tight_pair_second_look.source: lead decision 11/1, rule 1: on a pair inside tau_pre_r (L3) K4 (type dirt, reflection or unsure) and K12 (Spark confidence low) are notes, not caps, and the pair goes to the second look (Spark Open on the hackathon key, then the account key, then hosted Muse Spark 1.3), which may lower it (K7); with no usable answer (not asked, or every engine failed) they cap as before. Marks seen in one walk only and pairs in the band keep them as caps. An already-there call rests on geometry, the same spot in both walks, not on what the mark is; the second look compares the two crops and is the veto; without it, stay conservative. Absent (runs frozen before 11/1): K4 and K12 cap every pair

next_keyframe_pair.source: lead decision 11/1, rule 2: when a panel's chosen keyframe pair fails a view gate (G3, G4, G5, G8, G9), match tries the panel's other keyframe pairs (clean views first as prefer_clean picks them, then the product of the two keyframe scores, highest first, ties by keyframe index) and compares on the first that passes every gate; G1, G6, G7 and G10 stay panel-level. Each pair tried is recorded with its gates (matches.json kf_pairs_tried, the sheet's how-checked line). Absent (runs frozen before 11/1): one pair per panel

tight_pair_k5.source: lead decision 11/1 (second): with tight_pair_second_look on, K5 (the two marks typed as incompatible kinds) joins K4 and K12 on a pair inside tau_pre_r: a note once the second look answered, not a cap by itself, so the pair goes to the look (Spark Open first), which may lower it (K7); with no usable answer K5 caps as before. Walks and claims alike. Absent (runs frozen before this leaf, pairC_core3 among them): K5 caps a tight pair by itself

reshaped_panel.source: lead decision 11/1 (second): when G4 is the only failing gate on every keyframe pair tried and the best whitened mask IoU is in [reshape_iou_min, mask_iou_min), the panel is needs your eye (L7, outline changed in place) instead of not comparable, only if the best pair's two keyframe box aspect ratios agree within reshape_aspect_tol and, after a reshape_open_px opening, the largest blob of the whitened mask difference holds at least reshape_blob_share_min of it. A turned camera changes the aspect and spreads the difference along the outline; a crushed panel keeps the aspect and concentrates it. Never already there or new. Measured on one reshaped case (NHTSA 15759 left rear door: 0.4%, 64%) and seven viewpoint failures (each fails one test): estimates. Absent (runs frozen before this leaf): not comparable as before

reshape_iou_min.source: lead decision 11/1 (second), reshaped_panel: below it the outlines differ too much to call it the same panel reshaped

reshape_aspect_tol.source: lead decision 11/1 (second), reshaped_panel: |a - b| / max(a, b) of the two keyframe box aspect ratios

reshape_open_px.source: lead decision 11/1 (second), reshaped_panel: square opening on the whitened mask difference, removes the thin rim a small misregistration leaves

reshape_blob_share_min.source: lead decision 11/1 (second), reshaped_panel: the largest connected blob's share of the opened difference

one_walk_counter_look.source: lead decision 11/1 (third): a mark seen in one walk only (L1, L2, either mark of an L5 pair) whose label is new_or_unseen or not_seen_at_return with no cap goes to the second look with two outlined images, the mark's crop in its own walk and the other walk's crop of the same panel with the spot outlined (mapped through the whitened panel frame of the pair compared on, the handle residual undone; the box covers tau_pre_r around it). Same or unsure caps it at needs your eye (K16, the other walk may show it); different or no usable answer keeps the label. Same engine order as every look. Found on eval_px_two_takes: a parking-sensor dot Spark found in the return walk only came out new_or_unseen

counter_looks_max.source: lead decision 11/1 (third): at most this many counter-looks per run, Muse Spark's confidence on the mark highest first; the rest keep their label with a note

seams_not_marks.source: lead 11/1: spark_client.SEAMS_SENTENCE in the marks prompt. Tested on all 50 stored synth_pair2 crops, 2 answers per prompt (docs/evidence/seams_1101): false boxes 83 to 74, boxes on a ground-truth mark 5 to 3. Not adopted: the cut is small and the true finds fell

fixtures_not_damage.source: lead decision 4 of 11/1: factory fixtures are not damage. A mark whose box sits on a fixture the run already has (a fixture landmark Muse Spark pointed at in the same crop, or the SAM door-handle point of its keyframe) by at least fixture_overlap_min of its box is left out of matching and named in how_checked; and the marks_v1 prompt asks Spark not to box factory fixtures. Off when absent, so runs frozen before it rebuild unchanged

fixture_overlap_min.source: lead decision 4 of 11/1: the share of the mark's box inside the fixture's box at or above which the mark is a fixture (estimate; a mark that only touches a fixture stays)

fixture_half_grid.source: lead decision 4 of 11/1: the fixture landmarks and the half width and half height of each fixture's box around its point, on Spark's 0 to 1000 grid of the crop (estimates from typical part sizes on a door, bumper, hood or wheel crop; not measured). The SAM door-handle point uses handle

max_objects_per_clip.source: 5.9 item 1; API notes (16 objects per frame)

b1_floor.source: 5.9 item 5 (panel centroid displacement as a fraction of frame width)

cap_enabled.source: lead decision 10/31 after D1 on uCO3D pair C: real paint drifted 0.21 whitened units and was labelled sliding, and no reflection control exists on white paint; Stays Put records and shows but caps no verdict until recalibrated on dark paint (docs/D1_MEMO.md note 2)

min_drift_frames.source: estimate (whitened frames a drift needs before it is a number)

max_clips_per_walk.source: estimate (5 step 9: about 12 pickup or 10 return clips plus one control per walk)

window_mark_margin.source: estimate (a window side is at least 1.5 x the longest side of its marks)

control_blob_max_frac.source: estimate (of the hood mask; the control must also pass the 5.9 item 6 highlight test)

check_box_covered_min.source: estimate (share of a prompt-frame check box the walk's grown plate and face track boxes must cover, else the clip is refused)

clip_frames_max.source: estimate (3 s at 60 fps; a clip is 2 x round(clip_half_window_s x fps) + 1 frames)

neighbours_enabled.source: lead 10/31, docs/STAYS_PUT_ANCHORS.md: each clip also tracks rigid neighbours in the same SAM 3.1 request (no extra request); off plans clips as before

neighbours_max.source: lead 10/31, docs/STAYS_PUT_ANCHORS.md (up to 12 neighbours; marks plus neighbours stay within max_objects_per_clip)

neighbours_target.source: estimate (the window grows until it holds 6 neighbours; the two clips measured on 10/31 had 5 and 6)

neighbours_min.source: lead 10/31, docs/STAYS_PUT_ANCHORS.md (fewer than 4 neighbours tracked through the clip is inconclusive)

neighbour_track_share_min.source: lead 10/31, docs/STAYS_PUT_ANCHORS.md (a neighbour is in the fit when tracked on 80% of the clip)

neighbour_fixed_below.source: lead 10/31, docs/STAYS_PUT_ANCHORS.md (fixed when the mark's residual is under 1.5x its neighbours' in both windows; paint measured 0.6 and 0.8x, a crease 0.7 and 0.3x)

neighbour_sliding_above.source: lead 10/31, docs/STAYS_PUT_ANCHORS.md (sliding when over 2.5x in both windows; a reflection on the black S550 measured 4.8 and 3.8x)

neighbour_near_half_window_s.source: lead 10/31, docs/STAYS_PUT_ANCHORS.md (the second window, +/- 0.5 s around the prompt frame)

neighbour_window_margin.source: estimate (a neighbour's box sits inside the clip window with 15% to spare at the prompt frame)

neighbour_window_max_panel_frac.source: estimate (a clip window never grows past 1.5 x the panel's long side; the measured trunk clip used about 1.2)

neighbour_mark_min_clip_px.source: estimate (the window never grows so far that a mark falls under 16 clip pixels on its long side)

neighbour_part_max_window_frac.source: estimate (a lane part longer than half the window is too big to follow as one point)

neighbour_residual_floor_px.source: estimate (half a clip pixel, the step of a SAM box centre; keeps the ratio finite when neighbours do not move)

neighbour_dedupe_iou.source: estimate (two lane boxes overlapping this much are one part, e.g. the rear window seen by two lanes)

neighbour_handle_half_w_frac.source: estimate (the door handle box from its point: half width 0.08 x the door's width)

neighbour_handle_half_h_frac.source: estimate (half height 0.02 x the door's width)

neighbour_window_max_growth.source: integrator 10/31, on the Stays Put lane's live clips of the pair C trunk lid (ledger run id sp_neigh_pairC_1031): windows grown 2.4x and 3x the 400 px base (969 and 1181 px) lost the faint marks on 13 to 84 of 89 frames, while pairC_core1's 400 px windows held the chip, the scratch and one dirt mark on all 89; a window grows at most 2x its base side (estimate between the two; the S550 clips may then find fewer than 4 neighbours)

effort.source: 5 step 8 (set explicitly on every call; E6 may move it to medium)

stream_when_expected_over_s.source: 5 step 8 (non-streaming requests hit a server time limit, 504)

image_long_edge_px.source: 5.3; API notes (1,300 to 1,500 tokens at 1280 px; about 3,400 at 1600 px measured 10/26)

grid_slack.source: walkaround/spark_client.py draft (1001 clamps; farther off is dropped)

second_look_engine.source: integrator 10/31: Muse Spark Open on Baseten with hosted Muse Spark 1.3 answering when Baseten gives none (walkaround/second_look.py). B11 smokes on uCO3D pair C (b11_smoke_1031, b11_smoke_1031b, b11_fix_smoke_1031): 9 of 9 looks valid JSON on the first try, 6 of 6 control pairs different, the real chip pair same 3 of 3. E16's sigma part is not run. A look can only lower a label (K7); off turns it off

pin_fallback.source: 11 E10 fail branch, applied per piece by narration.pin_piece: when SAM shows none of the named slots during the piece, the slot of the named kind on screen at its start, printed about (side words set aside); named_panel_nearest keeps the words

chip_min_ms.source: estimate (a shorter turn gets no chip)

seeds_per_walk_max.source: estimate (distinct seed_v1 questions one walk may ask, about $0.005 each)

box_blocks_across.source: privacy lane 10/31, measured on pairC_core1: 5 px blocks on the 960 px display video left a 111 x 127 px plate box readable at 4.4 s of the return walk; every pixelated box or mask now spans at most 4 blocks on its long side (32 px blocks there), at any size

track_box_union_s.source: privacy lane 10/31: each sighting's box also covers the frames this close to it (2 at 15 fps), so a one-frame box glitch (pairC_core1 return frame 70, a 14 x 18 px box) never uncovers the plate

track_carry_s.source: privacy lane 10/31, measured on pairC_core1: the pickup rear plate shows edge-on from frame 185 (12.33 s), 30 frames before its track starts at frame 215 (14.33 s); a plate or face track is carried this long before each first sighting and after each last one. 3.0 (review fix 11/1): 2.0 had no margin, and on pairC_core2 the return front plate showed edge-on at frames 185 to 188, 31 to 34 frames before its track starts at frame 219

track_carry_fit_s.source: estimate (the sightings next to a track's edge that a carried box takes its size and speed from)

track_carry_grow_per_s.source: estimate (an extrapolated carried box grows by half its size per second carried; used where no optical flow follows it: crops, clips, and any display frame the flow loses)

track_carry_speed_max_frac_per_s.source: estimate (a carried box moves at most one frame width per second; the fastest pan on pairC_core1, pickup frames 194 to 196, was about 45 px a frame at 15 fps, 0.7 frame widths per second)

track_flow_grow_per_s.source: estimate (a carried box that optical flow follows on the display video grows by a fifth of its size per second, for drift; on pairC_core1 it stayed on the pickup rear plate over the 30 frames before that track starts, checked by eye)

track_flow_cover_path.source: review fix 11/1, measured on pairC_core1's return walk (the same original as pairC_core2's): before the front plate track starts at frame 216, optical flow carried its 21 x 14 px box 80 px to the right while the edge-on plate stayed near its first sighting, so frames 185 to 189 showed the plate strip outside the carried block even with a 3 s carry; each flow-carried box on the display video now also covers every box before it back to that sighting (display video only; crops and clips keep the extrapolated box and their own image checks)

track_flow_cover_max_frac.source: review fix 11/1, estimate: the path cover reaches at most this share of the frame's long edge past the carried box (96 px on the 960 px proxy; the drift measured above was 80 px), so a carry along a pan does not block a car's whole side (uncapped, pairC_core1's pickup had up to 26 percent of a frame under carried boxes)

daily_card_ceiling_cents.source: 9; raised to $50 by Sanat 11/1 1:15 AM ("feel free to spend more"), runs bill the $150 Meta credit

judging_card_ceiling_cents.source: 9 (the $50 ask in NEEDS_YOU; if no, caps drop to 3 pickup checks and no live pair)

run_deadline_s.source: 9 (whole-run deadline 12 min, then the partial sheet)

baseten_rpm.source: x-ratelimit-limit-requests 120 and x-ratelimit-limit-tokens 500000 on Baseten responses, 10/31 (run b11_fix_smoke_1031); looks run one at a time at 2.4 to 4.5 s, so 30 never binds

priority_wave_size.source: 5 step 5 (if first delta grows with request index)

plate_hw_min.source: estimate (polish lane, Oct 31): a 12 x 6 in plate seen up to 45 degrees from above reads h / w 0.5 x cos 45 = 0.35, while a European 520 x 110 mm or Indian 500 x 120 mm strip reads 0.21 to 0.24 frontal (the pair C front plate read 0.06 to 0.25 on pairC_core1); a flatter plate is refused as a ruler

threshold_body_scratch_in.source: 5.12 (Hertz REV 7.2025, 2 x 3.5 in card, illustrative only)

body_scuff_ordinary_wear.source: 5.12 (no size comparison for a body scuff)

camera_hfov_deg.source: estimate (the camera distance behind the ruler's depth term)

view_flag_sizes.source: lead decision 11/1 (2): Muse Spark's wet, dirty and glare flags are model judgments, so a flagged crop no longer refuses a size; the size prints with a note in the K15 words (return view flagged dirty: the size may include dirt) for the mark's keyframe and the keyframe the size was measured on. A dark crop and the geometric refusals stay (plate turned past 30 degrees, no wheel measured, no tire code). Absent (runs frozen before 11/1): any flagged crop refuses, so their sheets rebuild byte for byte

dark_v_max.source: estimate (pixels darker than this are left out of the claim's saturation tests: JPEG chroma noise)

on_panel_frac.source: how far off the panel mask a claim mark's point may sit, over the crop's long side: Spark point jitter on real marks 2.0 to 2.4% of crop width (D1 E6 re-run)

view_flag_caps.source: integrator 10/31, from the lead's decision of 10/31 (G2 retired: Spark's wet, dirty and glare are model judgments and only lower a label): a flagged pickup frame no longer stops a claim comparison; a claim mark the pickup walk shows nothing near gets K15 when no complete, sharp pickup frame of the panel is clean; absent (runs frozen before 10/31) keeps the old refusal, so their claims rebuild from what they recorded

photo_flag_caps_one_walk_only.source: review fix 11/1, the same decision for the claim photo: a wet, dirty or glare claim photo (E8) caps the claim mark with K11 only when no pickup mark lies within tau_eye_r of it; a pickup mark that near keeps its label and the paragraph names the flag, as a flagged return view does in the walk; absent (runs frozen before 11/1) keeps K11 on every E8 claim mark

footage_credit.source: review fix 11/1: the sheet, its PDF footer and the letter print the run's footage credit, with the license link when the credit names CC BY 4.0 or the Pexels License (CC BY 4.0 asks for the credit, the link and a note of changes wherever the modified frames are shared); absent (runs frozen before 11/1) keeps the old sheet, so those sheets rebuild byte for byte
